items.stem: Which keyboard shortcut reverses (undoes) the last edit in Microsoft Word and Windows applications?
items.explanation: Ctrl + Z performs Undo, whereas Ctrl + Y repeats/redoes an action, Ctrl + X cuts selected items, and Ctrl + U toggles underline formatting.

items.stem: Which type of computer memory is volatile and loses its stored contents immediately when electrical power is turned off?
items.explanation: RAM requires continuous power to retain active instructions and data; ROM and secondary drives (SSD/optical disks) are non-volatile.

items.stem: On which date did the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan (1973) come into formal force?
items.explanation: The National Assembly passed the 1973 Constitution on 10 April 1973, it was authenticated on 12 April 1973, and came into force on 14 August 1973.

items.stem: Where is the permanent Secretariat of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) located?
items.explanation: The SCO Secretariat is headquartered in Beijing, China, while its Regional Anti-Terrorist Structure (RATS) Executive Committee is based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
